sam-cs: Lina (Velvet) reporting a fresh onboarding hiccup. After our quickstart they see 403/429 on a small burst during worker start. only happens on k8s node rollouts.
lina-velvet: repro steps: deploy 10 replicas, each replica starts 4 init threads that call /v1/embeddings once. ~40 init requests in <2s, then ~10% fail with 429s. using python requests without session. token ok.
kevin (cs-eng): thanks — this looks like a connection storm + lack of connection reuse. python requests without a Session opens new sockets per call and can exhaust per-ip socket concurrency at our edge. can you share a sample client snippet?
lina-velvet: snippet: ```python
import requests
for i in range(4):
    requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json=payload, headers=headers)
```
kevin (cs-eng): yep. quick fixes: 1) use requests.Session() or httpx.AsyncClient() to reuse connections 2) stagger replica start with randomized delay 3) fallback: route init calls through a single warmup sidecar that serializes requests.
sam-cs: ops-bot can we temporarily relax the per-tenant concurrent-socket threshold for velvet-tenant while they roll this out? need a short window and alerting.
ops-bot: @ops oncall notified. Temporary adjustment: tenant=velvet-tenant concurrent_sockets=180 until 2026-03-10T12:00:00Z. Alert rule added for >120 sustained conns per minute.
kevin (cs-eng): share a minimal Session snippet for them to apply: ```python
import requests
s = requests.Session()
s.headers.update({'Authorization': f"Bearer {TOKEN}"})
resp = s.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json=payload)
```
kevin (cs-eng): if they can move to httpx: ```python
import httpx
with httpx.Client(http2=True) as client:
    client.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json=payload)
```
lina-velvet: implemented Session + randomized 0-1.5s startup jitter on each pod. first rollout: previously ~12 429s, now 0. will observe for 6h and report. thanks!
sam-cs: follow-ups: - add Python Session snippet to onboarding quickstart - add a checklist step in account health: verify connection reuse and warmup pattern during first 48h ramp - advise customers running many short-lived init connections to use a sidecar warmup or HTTP/2.
kevin (cs-eng): also adding a short KB entry about per-ip conn limits and node NAT effects. linking this thread in the KB.
sam-cs: marking this resolved pending 6h stable. reopen if issues recur. :white_check_mark:
